title: FEA doc front matter
description: Front matter on docs/simulation pages. Navigation titles stay in docs/catalog.json and manual.json; front matter carries search, agent and doc-type metadata. Written in the YAML subset `key: value`, `key: [a, b]` and `- item` lists.

description.description: Search and Open Graph summary; site search indexes title, summary and keywords.

keywords.description: Engineering terms a reader would search for ("von Mises", "Tet10", "modal analysis").

doc_type.description: The METHOD §1.2 doc type; it fixes the page template.

examples.description: Example catalog ids (docs/simulation/examples/catalog.json) the page uses.

generated.description: Command that regenerates this page; present only on generated pages.
